name: drivesync-monorepo
description: DriveSync — Sincronização simples multiplataforma com Google Drive, modo Master, filtro de remetentes e trava de 4 GB

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@drivesync/shared && npm run build --workspace=@drivesync/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@drivesync/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@drivesync/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:engine && npm run test:legacy
scripts.pack:linux: bash packaging/scripts/build-engine.sh current && npm run build --workspace=@drivesync/shared && npm run pack:linux --workspace=@drivesync/desktop
scripts.pack:win: bash packaging/scripts/build-engine.sh windows && npm run build --workspace=@drivesync/shared && npm run pack:win --workspace=@drivesync/desktop
